# REPCEE
> REPCEE is a sales, marketing, and consulting representation company helping hotels, resorts, and destination-management businesses reach travelers and industry partners across Central and Eastern Europe. It offers tailored sales plans, marketing campaigns, hotel-launch support, public relations, market research, trade events, and travel-industry partnerships, drawing on more than 15 years of experience and operations in Romania, Poland/Ukraine, and Dubai. The site describes the region’s tourism and economic potential, presents founders and selected hospitality clients, and provides contact details.
